page.layout: One column of table-of-contents entries, each exercitatio heading followed by its title and page reference, with a catchword and gathering signature at the foot. Left margin carries only edge marks and no printed text.

page.notes: The ornament before "An liceat pestem" and before "Defuga" is a decorative initial, not a letter, and is omitted. The Greek words on the L and LV lines are set in small type and are doubtful at the accent level, so they carry [?]. The "pap.267" and "p.266" references are printed as they stand. The left margin has pencil or ink marks and edge shadows, which are not printed text and are left out. The "** ij." signature is read from a small mark at the foot left and may be slightly off.
